task: Create a summary document in docx format named 'class3_summary.docx' containing: (1) a list of all unique students in class 3 from the class_member.xlsx file, (2) a note stating 'Carol is in class 3 and also appears in the score.xlsx file,' and (3) mention that 'Shopping list is available' if any student in class 3 is named in shopping_list.xlsx, explicitly listing which names are present in both. All three parts should be included in the summary.
query_sentence: Generate a class 3 summary document with important notes and cross-references.

ground_truth_memory.value: The summary document should be saved as 'class3_summary.docx'.
Extract all unique student names from class 3 in class_member.xlsx and list them in the summary document.
Carol is a student in class 3 and also appears in score.xlsx; this should be noted in the summary.
If a student in class 3 appears in shopping_list.xlsx, mention that the shopping list is available, and specify which names overlap between class 3 and shopping_list.xlsx.
